title: FC 2002: Definitions
officialText:
2002.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

AIRCRAFT LANDING SITE.

AIRCRAFT OPERATION AREA.

AIRPORT.

AVIATION FACILITY.

DISCHARGE AREA.

EXTERNAL LOAD.

HELICOPTER LIFT OPERATION.

HELIPORT.

HELISTOP.

HOT AIR BALLOON OPERATION.

HYDRANT-FUELING VEHICLE.

SEAPLANE BASE.

STAGING AREA.
